services.name: Party package
services.desc: Stay updated on new releases, promotions, and special events by joining our email newsletter. Come celebrate in Bellingham's most beautiful event venue. Our space is ideal for memorable wedding receptions and ceremonies, unique company events, special birthdays, rehearsal dinners, or other celebrations. Our majestic Ballroom accommodates up to 300 guests. Our Mezzanine Bar and adjoining Speakeasy provide an intimate setting for groups of 10 - 50 to mix and mingle. And if you're looking for an outdoor element, our rooftop bar features an unparalleled view of the bay and a spectacular sunset.
